description: Figure: conservation vs solvent accessibility for the IRG-2 conserved polar cluster, and the permutation null for its 3D clustering
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, networkx as nx
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import defaultdict

cdf=pd.read_csv("/agent/jobs/29937715-f3de-4c80-a203-a9ca6414aa2d/provenance/irg2_conservation_per_residue.csv")
pdbtxt=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O16224-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=60).text
sc=defaultdict(list)
for l in pdbtxt.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip() not in ("N","C","O"):
        sc[int(l[22:26])].append([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
cen={k:np.mean(v,0) for k,v in sc.items()}
core=cdf[(cdf.ncov>=20)&(cdf.pLDDT>=70)].copy()
POLAR=set("DEHKRSTYNQC")
pool=core[core.aa.isin(POLAR)].pos.tolist()
obs_set=core[(core.aa.isin(POLAR))&(core.frac_identical_to_IRG2>=0.50)].pos.tolist()
def biggest(ps):
    P=np.array([cen[p] for p in ps]); D=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None,:],axis=-1)
    G=nx.Graph(); G.add_nodes_from(ps)
    for i in range(len(ps)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(ps)):
            if D[i,j]<10: G.add_edge(ps[i],ps[j])
    return max(len(c) for c in nx.connected_components(G))
obs=biggest(obs_set); rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=np.array([biggest(list(rng.choice(pool,len(obs_set),replace=False))) for _ in range(5000)])
pval=(null>=obs).mean()
CLUST=[40,41,43,67,74,107,108,139,187]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,5.4))
ax=axes[0]
oth=core[~core.pos.isin(CLUST)]
ax.scatter(oth.rsa, oth.frac_identical_to_IRG2, s=28, c='#b8c4d4', edgecolor='none', label='other confident residues')
cl=cdf[cdf.pos.isin(CLUST)]
ax.scatter(cl.rsa, cl.frac_identical_to_IRG2, s=90, c='#c0392b', edgecolor='k', lw=.6, zorder=3, label='conserved polar cluster')
for _,r in cl.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(f"{r.aa}{int(r.pos)}",(r.rsa,r.frac_identical_to_IRG2),fontsize=9,xytext=(5,2),textcoords='offset points')
ax.axvline(0.20,color='k',ls='--',lw=1)
ax.text(0.205,0.12,'RSA = 0.20\nburied  |  exposed',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Relative solvent accessibility (Shrake-Rupley on the AlphaFold model)')
ax.set_ylabel('Fraction of 110 IRG2_ab proteins identical to IRG-2')
ax.set_title('The conserved polar network of IRG-2 is mostly buried\nmedian RSA 0.085 for the cluster against 0.303 for all confident residues',fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper right')

ax=axes[1]
ax.hist(null, bins=np.arange(1.5,13.5,1), color='#9bb7d4', edgecolor='w')
ax.axvline(obs, color='#c0392b', lw=2.5)
ax.text(obs+0.15, ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.75, f'observed = {obs}\np = {pval:.3f}', color='#c0392b', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel('Largest 10 A-linked cluster among 17 polar residues')
ax.set_ylabel('Permutations (of 5000)')
ax.set_title('Spatial clustering of the conserved polar residues is only\nborderline against random polar residues of the same core',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("cluster RSA median", round(cl.rsa.median(),3), " core RSA median", round(core.rsa.median(),3))
print("exposed cluster members (RSA>0.2):", cl[cl.rsa>0.2][['pos','aa','rsa']].to_string(index=False))
print("permutation p =", pval, " null mean", round(null.mean(),2))
